sanskrit_verse: āhartā śodhayed bhuktim āgamaṃ vāpi saṃsadi / tatputro bhuktim evaikāṃ pautrādis tu na kiṃcana // BrhS_1,7.39
transliteration: āhartā śodhayed bhuktim āgamaṃ vāpi saṃsadi / tatputro bhuktim evaikāṃ pautrādis tu na kiṃcana
sph_interpretive_translation: The originator shall restore the enjoyment or the gain acquired thereby in the assembly; the son of the originator shall restore only the enjoyment; but the grandson and further descendants shall restore nothing.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority diminishes with generational distance from the causal agent
Restoration logic is proportionate to direct causation and capacity
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of source-action integrity
Capacity-based responsibility decreases with relational remove from the act
executable_legal_axioms: IF Agent = Originator THEN Liability = Full Restoration of Gain OR Enjoyment IN Assembly Context
IF Agent = First-Descendant AND Originator's Lineage THEN Liability = Restore Only Enjoyment
IF Agent = Second-Descendant OR Beyond THEN Liability = No Restoration Required
IF Consciousness Acknowledgment = True THEN Restoration Eligibility Increases
IF Causal Distance > 1 THEN Legal Capacity For Restoration = Null
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes a threshold of actionable responsibility tied to both proximity to origination and awareness. Descendants beyond the first generation are not liable for restorative action unless conscious participation or benefit is proven. The court must assess lineage, causality, and consciousness, not merely inheritance or association.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This provision aligns with Nyaya through pramāṇa-based causality—only the āhartā (originator) bears full causal weight. Subsequent generations lack sufficient causal connection to warrant liability. The framework avoids punitive measures by focusing solely on experiential completion and energetic realignment rather than loss or penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assembly-Based Restoration Protocol: The originator must publicly restore enjoyment or gain within the governing council.
First-Descendant Completion Process: Son or daughter restores experiential residue without financial burden.
Generational Consciousness Audit: Evaluate awareness and benefit in later descendants before any engagement.
Integrity Reintegration for Originator: Mandatory alignment session to reaffirm causal ownership and dissolve distortion.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored. Responsibility flows from causation. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
